title: Understanding L2 Regularization
text: L2 regularization, also known as Ridge Regression, adds a penalty equal to the square of the magnitude of coefficients to the loss function. This helps in reducing overfitting by discouraging overly complex models.

title: Effect on Training Set
text: When L2 regularization is applied, the model complexity is reduced. This can lead to a decrease in the variance of the model's predictions on the training set.

title: Bias-Variance Tradeoff
text: Regularization typically increases bias but decreases variance. Consider how this tradeoff affects the model's performance on the training set.

title: Impact on Observational Variance
text: Does adding L2 regularization increase or decrease the variance of the model's predictions on the training set?
